digest.component_or_area: Dockerized live Jira DC verification harness (external test tier)
propositions: Build a Dockerized Jira 8.17.1 DC harness as a verification oracle since no DC license, trial, or OpenAPI spec is available for contract testing.
The harness must be built from a vendored Dockerfile pinning the addono base by digest, not pulled, because pycontribs/jira-test-image is an unpublished local build name.

The vendored entrypoint must keep -DskipAllPrompts=true and -Dproduct.start.timeout, since removing them causes silent cold-start failures against the retired Marketplace v1 endpoint and Cargo's 600000ms deploy ceiling.

Jira is downloaded at runtime from maven.atlassian.com, making network egress a hard dependency and meaning the base digest does not pin Jira itself; readiness budget must cover the ~900-artifact fetch.

The harness runs only in the external tier under tests/external/, gated by REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL, skipping (not failing) when the instance is absent, with an all-skip canary preventing vacuous green runs.
Smoke tests prove REST v2 create/read round-trip and PAT bearer auth on a real 8.x Server deployment, with index-independent teardown asserting 404 on direct issue endpoints per ADR 0037.
